item.tib: 'bras sgrub kyi yig chung gnad sgron mdzes pa'i zur rgyan
item.coloph: de ltar brtsams tshul ni/ ring lugs bon gyi mtha'i rgyal khams dbus/ 'chad nyan rtsom pa gdong lnga'i khri 'phang rtser/ sngon sbyangs mes po'i lung gis cher bton pa'i/ bon 'khor bsgyur rgyal rin chen 'od zer gyis/ dbang chen bsnyen sgrub las sde re re la/ don lnga gsal ba'i yig chung me long re/ gnang yang zhing 'dir ma mjal kho bo yis/ gang gi man ngag gnad kyi sgron ma las/ ting 'dzin rim pa 'di ltar bya gsungs pa/ phyogs tsam 'dug pa de ka gzhir bzhag nas/ rdzogs pa chen po rnal 'byor nyams len dus/ spros te brtsams la nyes par nongs gyur na/ dpal ldan rtsa rgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i yi dam gtso 'khor bcas/ dam tshig ting 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ rnam dkar las smon ston zla'i rjes bsnyeg shog rgyal ba'i ming gis shel brag zhol 'dabs su/ sbyar bas rjes 'jug blo gros kun d+ha'i tshal/ bzhad nas rgyal bstan zhabs 'degs mchod rdzas su/ pha rol dkar po'i tshal chen rgyas 'gyur cig/
